raw_text: WE HAVE BREACHED ISRO TELEMETRY SERVERS. Full access to satellite control systems. Downloaded 2.3 TB of classified data including GSAT-30 orbital parameters and NavIC encryption keys. India's entire space program is compromised. Screenshots attached. We are CyberVandals — fear us. Data dump coming in 48 hours unless our demands are met.
clean_text: Threat actor claims breach of ISRO telemetry servers with 2.3 TB data exfiltrated including GSAT-30 parameters and NavIC encryption keys. Threatens data dump in 48 hours. Group identifies as CyberVandals.
